final: WITH per_frequency AS (SELECT a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN 1.0 * t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -1.0 * t.amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(1.0 * t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY a.frequency), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS mean_signed_amount FROM per_frequency) SELECT AVG(p.avg_signed_amount) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(p.avg_balance) AS avg_balance, AVG(p.avg_signed_amount - m.mean_signed_amount) AS avg_excess FROM per_frequency AS p CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m WHERE p.avg_signed_amount > m.mean_signed_amount
